spiked.prompt: 16-bit pixel art, top-down view (strictly perpendicular, no 3/4 angle) viewed from directly above, isolated on pure black background. Sharp clean pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, limited palette (max 12 colors), Metal Slug / Star Fox 64 aesthetic. Subject: a single rocky asteroid. Style: SPIKED variant — 3-4 sharp mineral protrusions sticking out, angular crystalline silhouette. Mandatory elements: - irregular polygon outline with 12-16 craggy edges (asymmetric, not circle); - 2-3 horizontal Greek-key stripe bands (Star Fox 64 angular pattern: right-angle hooks at band ends); - 2-4 small craters scattered on the body; - 1-2 thin surface cracks; - 1-3 small mineral highlights (1-2px speckles). LOCKED 6-color palette (exact RGB values, no new colors): base_brown (140, 100, 60), highlight (180, 140, 90), mid_shadow (90, 60, 30), deep_shadow (50, 30, 15), black_crack (20, 10, 5), mineral_hi (210, 170, 110). The asteroid is a MINE-ASTEROID closed lookalike: the body could split horizontally to reveal a hidden gun, but stays closed in this view.
